fields.description: Leading 8 bytes of the 448-byte save image (EEPROM block 0 head). Read as zero in the live capture; precedes the checksum slot so the u32 checksum stays 4-aligned.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800f4d0 writes 0x38 blocks of 8 bytes from the RAM save-image base (EEPROM addresses 0..0x37, file [0,448) in rev8-logical domain); FUN_0800f77c stores the u32 checksum at image base + 8. Bytes [0,8) are image prologue, all zero in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: save_image_prefix

fields.description: First persisted payload word at RAM buffer DAT_0800f7f0 + 0. Live value 1 in the captured save; covered by the payload checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800f77c checksums 0x1b4 bytes at DAT_0800f7f0 via FUN_0800f568 and persists them with FUN_0800f4d0 starting at EEPROM block 0, so buffer offset +0 maps to file offset 12 (rev8 logical). Live u16_le value 1 verified in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: payload_word_0

fields.description: Second persisted payload word at RAM buffer DAT_0800f7f0 + 2. Live value 1 in the captured save; covered by the payload checksum.
fields.evidence: Same write path as payload_word_0 (FUN_0800f77c / FUN_0800f568 / FUN_0800f4d0): buffer offset +2 maps to file offset 14 (rev8 logical). Live u16_le value 1 verified in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: payload_word_1

fields.description: Zero-filled payload span between the leading word pair and the payload-offset-60 word pair. Purpose undecoded; mapped as opaque bytes so no semantics are asserted.
fields.evidence: Span lies inside the FUN_0800f568 checksum range [12,448) and the FUN_0800f4d0 0x38-block write window; all 56 bytes read 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav (rev8 logical).
fields.name: payload_gap_a

fields.description: Persisted payload word at RAM buffer DAT_0800f7f0 + 60. Live value 3 in the captured save; covered by the payload checksum.
fields.evidence: Same write path as payload_word_0 (FUN_0800f77c / FUN_0800f568 / FUN_0800f4d0): buffer offset +60 maps to file offset 72 (rev8 logical). Live u16_le value 3 verified in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: payload_word_30

fields.description: Persisted payload word at RAM buffer DAT_0800f7f0 + 62. Live value 3 in the captured save; covered by the payload checksum.
fields.evidence: Same write path as payload_word_0 (FUN_0800f77c / FUN_0800f568 / FUN_0800f4d0): buffer offset +62 maps to file offset 74 (rev8 logical). Live u16_le value 3 verified in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: payload_word_31

fields.description: Zero-filled payload span between the payload-offset-60 word pair and the 0xFFFF lead word. Purpose undecoded; mapped as opaque bytes.
fields.evidence: Span lies inside the FUN_0800f568 checksum range [12,448) and the FUN_0800f4d0 0x38-block write window; all 60 bytes read 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav (rev8 logical).
fields.name: payload_gap_b

fields.description: Persisted payload word at RAM buffer DAT_0800f7f0 + 124 reading 0xFFFF in the live capture. Pattern suggests a guard/terminator word ahead of the uniform table, but no accessor was resolved, so this stays a structural reading.
fields.evidence: Same write path as payload_word_0 (FUN_0800f77c / FUN_0800f568 / FUN_0800f4d0): buffer offset +124 maps to file offset 136 (rev8 logical). Live u16_le value 0xFFFF verified in samples/baseline.sav; per-field readers sit behind unrecovered indirect calls.
fields.name: payload_word_62

fields.description: Six zero bytes directly after the 0xFFFF word and before the uniform table. Purpose undecoded; mapped as opaque bytes.
fields.evidence: Span lies inside the FUN_0800f568 checksum range [12,448) and the FUN_0800f4d0 0x38-block write window; all 6 bytes read 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav (rev8 logical).
fields.name: payload_tail_zeros

fields.description: 300-byte uniform region repeating the byte pair F0 D2 (u16 0xD2F0 in rev8-logical domain). Game-written and checksum-covered, but encoding is undecoded, so mapped as opaque bytes with no gameplay claim.
fields.evidence: Written by the FUN_0800f4d0 block loop (EEPROM blocks 18..55, file [144,444) rev8 logical) and covered by the FUN_0800f568 checksum, which verifies byte-exact over it. Uniform 2-byte period verified in samples/baseline.sav; no constant 0xD2F0/0xF0D2 or accessor appears in the resolved decomp.
fields.name: uniform_data_table

fields.description: Final word of the 436-byte checksummed payload (buffer offset +432). Reads zero in the live capture.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800f568 sums buffer bytes [DAT_0800f7f0, DAT_0800f7f0 + 0x1b4), i.e. file [12,448) rev8 logical; the last word at file [444,448) reads u32_le 0 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: payload_trailer

fields.description: Bytes past the 56-block save image. Never written by the game; erased EEPROM state (0xFF).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800f4d0 is always called from FUN_0800f77c with count 0x38, so only EEPROM blocks 0..0x37 (file [0,448)) are written; file [448,512) reads 0xFF throughout in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: unwritten_erased_area
